name: stats-row
title: Stats row
description: Two to four KPI cards in a row for dashboards and settings overviews.

standards.purpose: Compare two to four metrics side by side.
useWhen: A view needs its key numbers above the fold.
doNotUseWhen: Five or more metrics compete — pick the four that decide.

rules.check: Two to four stat cards; the columns axis matches the stat count.
